WorkflowCoach is currently in a restricted private beta phase, enabled for approximately 11% of NovaLearn AI's active customers, primarily mid-market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing, who are testing it on factory-floor safety checks and assembly line onboarding [NL-002-S07][NL-014-S05]. Feedback from this private beta has highlighted the need for offline caching of step lists and automated photo verification of physical tasks [NL-014-S05].

The official public beta target is September 2026, with engineering specification v2.9.0 scheduling the release for September 29, 2026 [NL-002-S07][NL-014-S05][NL-015-S05][NL-014-S03]. However, informal internal sources indicate this timeline is at risk. Engineering standups and leadership reviews indicate dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and Okta permission synchronization engine may slip the release to November 2026 [NL-002-S07][NL-014-S05]. The CTO, Leon Grayson, stated the September target is in serious jeopardy due to roadblocks with the state management engine (high latency up to 4 seconds during step transitions) and permission inheritance failures where restricted information is not hidden from unauthorized users [NL-015-S05]. In response, a contingency plan has been drafted: a limited private beta in September is possible only for customers with flat document structures and no sensitive compliance data, while the full public beta is contemplated for November; regulated clients like BrightPath Healthcare cannot compromise [NL-015-S05]. An internal product update is due by July 5 detailing the features deferred to November (such as cross-workspace permission synchronization) and the criteria for the September private beta cohort [NL-015-S09].

Planned core capabilities include parsing procedural documents into sequential blocks, guiding employees step-by-step with confirmations, photo uploads, and compliance questions, and recording every step in the tenant's compliance log, flagging skipped steps and notifying supervisors [NL-002-S07]. WorkflowCoach is designed to link procedural checklists directly to authoritative SOP documents in KnowledgeHub to ensure frontline staff execute tasks per corporate standards [NL-001-S03].
